tests.name: after VS Code restarts with the installed daemon stopped, the daemon is running and the status bar shows it

reported.evidence: Run by the user on 2026-10-16 with the rebuilt vsix installed (build cb91914f). First run (build 6f330297, before the settled ordering): with the daemon stopped, a window reload started it, but a stale 'daemon is not running - start the daemon' toast also appeared (the settings pull raced the start); that run is not counted as a pass and led to the onSettled ordering. Second run (cb91914f): the daemon was restarted by the extension and the update check found nothing to update because the daemon was already at origin. Third run, after pushing main so origin was ahead of the installed daemon: the user stopped the daemon, reloaded, and reported the single word 'worked'. I read that as: the daemon started on its own with no stale toast and the update check ran (Update prompt) in the same activation. The user's reply did not itemise those observations, so this is recorded as reported on that reading, not independently confirmed.
